in_marathi.name: Darbhika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's foot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darbhika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Darpa’ meaning ‘foot’ and ‘Bhiksha’ meaning ‘beg’ or ‘ask’. The name Darbhika symbolizes the Goddess Durga, who is revered for her courage and strength. She is believed to have saved the Devas by stepping on Mahishasura, the demon king, with her foot. This name is given to a girl who is believed to possess the courage and strength of Goddess Durga.
